metadata.title: Survey Data Protection

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for protecting collected survey data from inappropriate access, misuse, or secondary disclosure.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Survey response storage, data access controls, aggregation mechanisms, export tooling, and data analytics platforms.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for governing access, handling, and reuse of collected survey data.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Survey data protection assumes baseline survey authority, purpose clarity, and response integrity.

metadata.remarks: Survey Data Protection defines trust properties required to safeguard survey responses after collection. This pattern addresses access control, aggregation safeguards, export and reuse risk, and auditability, without addressing respondent consent or ethical approval processes.

components.title: Survey Response Access Control
components.description: Restricts access to raw and processed survey responses to authorized roles.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of valid accounts to access survey response data.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Role-based access control limiting who can view survey data.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Access to survey response data is explicitly managed.
Privileges to view or export survey responses follow least privilege.

components.title: Survey Aggregation and Exposure Safeguards
components.description: Prevents disclosure of sensitive information through small-group or attribute-based aggregation.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Inference of individual responses from aggregated survey results.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Aggregation thresholds and suppression to reduce inference risk.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Survey reporting features are constrained to reduce re-identification risk.
Policies define acceptable aggregation and reporting thresholds.

components.title: Survey Data Export and Secondary Use Control
components.description: Governs export, reuse, and downstream sharing of survey datasets.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Exfiltration of survey data via export or secondary sharing.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Policy enforcement constraining secondary use of collected data.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Controls reduce risk of inappropriate dissemination of survey data.
Policies define permissible secondary uses of survey responses.

components.title: Survey Data Protection Auditability
components.description: Provides traceability of access, analysis, and export of survey data.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Suppression of evidence related to improper survey data use.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Audit logging to support oversight and investigation.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Survey data access and handling events are logged.
Audit review supports detection of inappropriate survey data use.
